description.value:
You draw upon the collective's memory of wildshaping to sharpen one of your senses into the acuity of a great beast. Choose one of the following sense modifications: you develop low-light vision (sight), gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks that rely on hearing, or gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to Track by scent. The chosen modification persists for the duration.

Heightened (2nd) Choose two sense modifications instead of one.

Heightened (3rd) Gain all three sense modifications. The Perception bonus (hearing) and Survival bonus (scent) each increase to +3.
